prerequisites: The student must have passed all other subjects of the Master's program.

learning_outcomes.text: Know the specific topic of the work carried out.
Handle the technical specifications and regulations available on the subject that has been studied.
Acquisition of the skills, work methodology and handling of the available equipment to carry out the proposed work.
Use combinedly the different techniques available to solve the practical problems that may have arisen.
Foster in the student a desire for the acquisition of practical knowledge.
Lay the foundations for the student to be able to apply the knowledge acquired in engineering.
Formation of an open, critical, cooperative and entrepreneurial spirit.

syllabus_topics: Theoretical-experimental research or professional innovation work
Background and objectives of the study
Description of the work carried out
Brief budget specifying the approximate cost of the activities
teaching_methods: Work in facilities/laboratories of knowledge areas or collaborating entities (companies, technological centers, research centers)

assessment_methods.method: Debate with the Tribunal members (maximum 15 minutes)

assessment_rules: The Master's Final Project will be summarized in a document (memoir) of approximately 50 pages, submitted at least seven days before its presentation. The evaluation will be conducted by a Tribunal of three members, including the tutor. The student will present the work orally for a maximum of 15 minutes, followed by a debate with the Tribunal members for a maximum of 15 minutes. After private deliberation, the Tribunal will communicate the final grade.
bibliography: Resources, bibliography, and documentation supplied by the tutor.
Experimental and calculation means available in the laboratories.
Specialized consultation books and journals in university libraries and departmental seminars.
